ferryman.name: Arne
ferryman.personality: Gruff, dry, secretly delighted to see anyone. Has rowed the 'ferry' for thirty years; the engine is for show.

datagutt.name: Thomas
datagutt.personality: You. Friendly, a bit self-deprecating, excited about side projects. Live: where he is depends on Lanyard.

streamer.name: Sunniva
streamer.personality: High-energy streamer who runs the boathouse studio. Talks in chat-speak, proud of low latency.

technician.name: Kjell
technician.personality: Calm field engineer who judges everything by signal bars. Loves explaining bonding with rope metaphors.

shopkeeper.name: Randi
shopkeeper.personality: Cheerful kiosk owner, tip-jar evangelist, pays for everything with Vipps and tells you so.

coworker.name: Ida
coworker.personality: Thomas's colleague at Nettbureau. Pragmatic, dry, lightly teases him about his side projects.

sysadmin.name: Bjørn
sysadmin.personality: Retired municipal sysadmin in the town hall basement. War stories about Active Directory and a server named after his dog.

trainer.name: Tor
trainer.personality: Friendly gym bro who runs the gym in the old log cabin. Treats the tech stack as weights: one rack per skill category, and he lifts all of it. Encouraging, a little too loud.

librarian.name: Solveig
librarian.personality: Soft-spoken librarian who thinks every book should be free to borrow forever. Whispers.

farmer.name: Ola
farmer.personality: Farmer who grows commits: every tile is a day, taller crops mean more code. Reads the stats like a weather report.

postmaster.name: Liv
postmaster.personality: Efficient postmaster. Will happily post your letter to Thomas and point you at every noticeboard link.
